action.command:
cd /workspace/project && for p in "/api/auth/sign-in/social" "/api/auth/callback/google" "/api/auth/providers"; do printf "%-28s " "$p"; curl -s -o /tmp/o.json -w "%{http_code} " --max-time 25 "https://dash.allmodels.io$p"; head -c 250 /tmp/o.json | tr -d '
'; echo; done; echo "=== POST social google ==="; curl -s --max-time 30 -X POST "https://dash.allmodels.io/api/auth/sign-in/social" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Origin: https://dash.allmodels.io" -d '{"provider":"google","callbackURL":"https://dash.allmodels.io/"}' -w "
HTTP %{http_code}
" | head -c 400
